title: No American flag on the sport model

tellings.quote: on this sport model they I saw that like the first day that I went in.

plain: Bob Lazar says that in 1988 or 1989 he worked on flying saucers at S-4, a secret site in Nevada, and that the craft he calls the "sport model" had no American flag or markings on it, which would point away from it being a US-built aircraft. Lazar tells Michels he saw this himself, "like the first day that I went in."
